_readme: Add one record per country code ONLY with real evidence. Required keys: carrier, carrierEvidence, shippingQuoteTest, paymentMethod, paymentTestResult, returnsPolicy, refundConditions, taxCustomsResponsibility, reviewerName, verificationDate (YYYY-MM-DD), evidenceSource, approvalStatus ('approved'). Run: node tools/build-evidence-register.mjs. A market qualifies for promotion only when no field is missing.
